nodes.name: OpenClaw skills subsystem
nodes.summary: src/skills implements SKILL.md discovery, frontmatter parsing, precedence merge, gating, snapshot/prompt catalog, slash commands, ClawHub lifecycle, security scanning and the Skill Workshop; skills are prompt instructions, not tools.

nodes.name: @openclaw/plugin-sdk
nodes.summary: Private workspace package exposing a large subpath export map; each subpath re-exports the real implementation from src/plugin-sdk so plugins import openclaw/plugin-sdk/<name>.

nodes.name: SKILL.md format
nodes.summary: A skill is a directory with SKILL.md: YAML frontmatter (name, description required) plus markdown body; nested metadata.openclaw is a JSON5 blob. Body references {baseDir} and reads helper scripts/references beside SKILL.md.

nodes.name: Skill precedence
nodes.summary: Name-keyed merge across ordered roots: extra/plugin < bundled < custodian < workshop < managed < personal < workspace; a higher tier's skill shadows a same-named lower-tier skill and collisions are logged.

nodes.name: Skill gating
nodes.summary: Load-time filter combining agent allowlist (agents entries/defaults), skills.entries enable/disable, bundled allowlist, secret-owner degradation, and requires.bins/env/config plus os/always eligibility.

nodes.name: Skill snapshot & refresh
nodes.summary: Eligible skills are snapshotted at session start and refreshed on SKILL.md watcher changes, Gateway restart, new remote node, or exhausted watch capacity; managed library pins revisions until explicit refresh.

nodes.name: Skill surface to callable
nodes.summary: Eligible skills surface three ways: <available_skills> XML in the system prompt, skills_search/skills_read tools for omitted catalogs, and user-invocable slash commands / $name references; command-dispatch:tool routes straight to a tool.

nodes.name: Plugin capability registry
nodes.summary: Native plugins register tools, channels, providers, hooks, services, routes and CLI into PluginRegistry; core reads the registry instead of importing plugin modules, keeping loading one-way.

nodes.name: Plugin activation boundary
nodes.summary: api.registrationMode (full/discovery/tool-discovery/setup-only/setup-runtime/cli-metadata) plus manifest activation/setup hints narrow plugin loading; only full mode receives the live runtime.

nodes.name: Native plugin in-process trust
nodes.summary: Native plugins run in-process with the Gateway and are not sandboxed; a malicious plugin equals arbitrary code execution, so plugins.allow is an id-level permit, not source verification.

nodes.name: ClawHub trust gate
nodes.summary: Exact-release security verdict mapped to clean/review-recommended/review-required/blocked, with fail-closed publisher-handle matching, before any plugin or skill archive is installed.

nodes.name: Custodian skills
nodes.summary: Release-versioned operational playbooks under custodian-skills/ that load at the bundled tier only for agents.defaults.systemAgent.agentId; they use the Gather/Mutate/Repair/Prove/Report contract and get no extra tools.

nodes.name: Plugin-declared skills
nodes.summary: Plugins list skills directories in openclaw.plugin.json; OpenClaw validates and publishes them as generated symlinks under ~/.openclaw/plugin-skills so they load at the low extraDirs precedence tier.

nodes.name: Bundled extensions
nodes.summary: extensions/* are bundled plugins: each ships openclaw.plugin.json plus entry code and optional skills dirs; bundled trust is resolved from the on-disk source snapshot, not install metadata.

nodes.name: openclaw.json skills/plugins config
nodes.summary: Config namespace governing skills (entries, allowBundled, load.extraDirs/allowSymlinkTargets/watch, install) and plugins (enabled, allow, deny, entries, slots, load.paths).

nodes.name: skills frontmatter
nodes.summary: Parses SKILL.md frontmatter, resolves metadata.openclaw, invocation policy and the skill key; validates installer specs.

nodes.name: shared frontmatter helpers
nodes.summary: Generic frontmatter helpers shared with plugin manifests: JSON5 metadata block resolution, requires/os normalization, install-entry parsing.

nodes.name: markdown-core frontmatter parser
nodes.summary: YAML-first frontmatter block parser with issue reporting and single-line fallback; parseFrontmatterBlockResult returns parsed frontmatter plus issues.

nodes.name: Skill contract & prompt rendering
nodes.summary: Defines the Skill interface and renders the full/compact <available_skills> prompt catalog with XML escaping and budget-bounded descriptions.

nodes.name: skill precedence merge
nodes.summary: Name-keyed merge of skill records, lower-precedence append and collision reporting grouped by root pair and source kind.

nodes.name: skill root discovery
nodes.summary: Bounded recursive SKILL.md discovery with root-containment and symlink-escape guards, plus validated plugin-skill symlink discovery.

nodes.name: workspace skill source plan
nodes.summary: Assembles the ordered low-to-high skill root plan (extra, plugin, bundled, custodian, workshop, managed, personal, workspace) and splits gateway/workspace plans.

nodes.name: workspace skill roots
nodes.summary: Resolves <workspace>/skills and <workspace>/.agents/skills with skills/ taking precedence, plus execution-workspace normalization.

nodes.name: skill entry filter
nodes.summary: Single gating seam: composes agent/session selection with shouldIncludeSkill eligibility; also resolves the effective workspace skill filter.

nodes.name: skills config gating
nodes.summary: shouldIncludeSkill, bundled allowlist, config/env requirement checks, secret-owner degradation, and async binary probe preparation.

nodes.name: workspace skill loader
nodes.summary: Loads agent and execution tiers, merges with precedence, applies library selections, probes binaries and returns eligible entries with retry semantics.

nodes.name: local skill loader
nodes.summary: Boundary-safe SKILL.md read (symlink/hardlink policy, byte cap) then parse + materialize into a Skill.

nodes.name: skill materializer
nodes.summary: Builds the Skill value, deriving displayName from the first markdown H1 and humanizing the identifier as fallback.

nodes.name: skills prompt catalog parser
nodes.summary: Reads back name/location identities from a rendered <available_skills> block without importing the session runtime.

nodes.name: plugin skills bridge
nodes.summary: Resolves plugin-declared skill roots from the metadata snapshot, validates containment, publishes generated symlinks, and serves plugin skill previews.

nodes.name: agent skill filter
nodes.summary: Resolves per-agent skills allowlist with defaults fallback and applies the sparse session skill override.

nodes.name: skill command specs
nodes.summary: Builds user-invocable slash command specs from eligible skills with unique-name resolution and command provenance.

nodes.name: chat skill commands
nodes.summary: Public command-listing contracts per workspace and per agent set, including remote-workspace gateway-only handling.

nodes.name: skill tool dispatch
nodes.summary: Policy-enforcement seam for command-dispatch:tool; builds the OpenClaw tools and applies the full tool-policy pipeline before a skill command runs a tool.

nodes.name: skill source scanner
nodes.summary: Static dangerous-pattern scanner for skill sources and directory summaries used before install/audit.

nodes.name: skill bundle scan
nodes.summary: Scans a skill bundle file set and asserts the bundle carries no literal secrets.

nodes.name: ClawHub skill lifecycle
nodes.summary: Install, update, verify and uninstall orchestration for tracked ClawHub skills, including preflight owner state and lockfile reconciliation.

nodes.name: ClawHub skill install core
nodes.summary: Version resolution, mutable-Git-ref rejection, trust check and archive download/verification for ClawHub skill installs.

nodes.name: installed skill tools
nodes.summary: Creates the skills_search and skills_read agent tools over the eligible installed catalog, binding read authority to body indexing.

nodes.name: installed skill catalog
nodes.summary: Lexical search and whole-file read over eligible skills, with a 256 KiB instruction cap and coverage reporting.

nodes.name: system prompt skills section
nodes.summary: Builds the ## Skills prompt section: scan available_skills, read the exact location or use skills_read/skills.search.

nodes.name: plugin manifest types
nodes.summary: Defines PluginManifest: id + configSchema required plus capabilities, contracts, activation, setup, skills, mcpServers, CLI, dashboard, backup and QA descriptors.

nodes.name: plugin registry types
nodes.summary: PluginRegistry records loaded plugin identity/source/status plus arrays for every capability family core consumes.

nodes.name: plugin lifecycle
nodes.summary: Runtime application receipts, lifecycle reasons and the restart-required / persisted-install error contracts for reload.

nodes.name: plugin enable
nodes.summary: Config-mutation helpers that honor plugins.enabled, deny and allow lists, with explicit-selection allowlisting and capability consent.

nodes.name: plugin install source plan
nodes.summary: Plans plugin installs from source specs (clawhub, npm, git, local, marketplace, npm-pack) and resolves official external catalog entries.

nodes.name: plugin install security scan
nodes.summary: Lazy-bound install policy and security scanning of bundle sources, package sources, dependency trees, npm and git preflights.

nodes.name: bundle manifest
nodes.summary: Detects and loads compatible bundle manifests (Agent Plugins, Codex, Claude, Cursor) and their component path lists.

nodes.name: plugin catalog discovery
nodes.summary: Joins ClawHub and local plugin catalog entries into detail/inspection views and browses or keyword-searches the ClawHub catalog.

nodes.name: plugin catalog search
nodes.summary: Search seam over installable plugin packages.

nodes.name: plugin management service
nodes.summary: Reads plugin inventory and inspection metadata (list/inspect, capabilities, credentials, icons, trust) without loading install orchestration.

nodes.name: prepared message tool catalog
nodes.summary: Registry-owned channel message-tool metadata prepared once per channel registry generation so the shared message tool exposes the right actions.

nodes.name: plugin entry SDK
nodes.summary: definePluginEntry normalizes a plugin definition (id/name/description/register plus lazily-evaluated configSchema) and re-exports the public SDK type surface.

nodes.name: channel entry contract
nodes.summary: defineBundledChannelEntry / defineBundledChannelSetupEntry plus bundled entry export loading, handling the registration-mode split for channels.

nodes.name: plugin-sdk package
nodes.summary: Private package whose exports map publishes dozens of narrow subpaths, each pointing at src/plugin-sdk implementations.

nodes.name: plugin-sdk entry shim
nodes.summary: Re-export shim: packages/plugin-sdk/src/plugin-entry.ts re-exports src/plugin-sdk/plugin-entry.js for the published subpath.

nodes.name: plugin loader facade
nodes.summary: Stable public facade over plugin loading and runtime-registry resolution (loadPluginRegistryHandle, loadOpenClawPlugins, registry cache helpers).

nodes.name: plugin runtime load
nodes.summary: Native composition entry that binds auth/profile/model/catalog callbacks and enters the shared loader without doing work at construction time.

nodes.name: OpenClaw tool assembly
nodes.summary: Assembles the agent tool surface, merging plugin tool allow/deny policy, media tools, sandbox bridge and tool-availability descriptions.

nodes.name: ClawHub client
nodes.summary: Bounded HTTP client for clawhub.ai with base-URL/token resolution, retries, and 256 MiB archive / 16 MiB JSON caps.

nodes.name: ClawHub install trust
nodes.summary: Shared exact-release trust gate for plugin and skill installs: fetches security verdicts, maps dispositions, enforces publisher handle and exposes fail-closed error codes.

nodes.name: ClawHub plugin skill preview
nodes.summary: Fetches a ClawHub release inventory and one selected SKILL.md body for preview without downloading or installing, enforcing bundle limits.

nodes.name: discord bundled plugin manifest
nodes.summary: Bundled Discord channel plugin manifest: declares channels, doctor contract, activation onStartup:false, skills directory and transcript sources.

nodes.name: telegram bundled plugin manifest
nodes.summary: Bundled Telegram channel plugin manifest with channel ownership, doctor state migrations and activation hints.

nodes.name: bundled clawhub skill
nodes.summary: Bundled skill that teaches the agent to search/install/verify skills and plugins and to delegate publishing/syncing to the standalone clawhub CLI.

nodes.name: custodian configure-channel skill
nodes.summary: Custodian playbook that configures a channel family and proves it with a confirmed test message under the Gather/Mutate/Repair/Prove/Report contract.

nodes.name: Skills reference
nodes.summary: Canonical skills doc: loading order, node-hosted skills, allowlists, SKILL.md format, gating, install/verify, security, snapshots, search, token impact.

nodes.name: Creating skills guide
nodes.summary: Step-by-step SKILL.md authoring, personal skills, gating, env wiring and learned-skill guidance.

nodes.name: Custodian skills doc
nodes.summary: Documents custodian ownership resolution, the five-section playbook contract, the first wave and roadmap tiers.

nodes.name: Plugin architecture
nodes.summary: Public capability model, plugin shapes, ownership/enforcement, execution model (in-process, unsandboxed) and trust notes.

nodes.name: Plugin manifest doc
nodes.summary: openclaw.plugin.json requirements, control-plane-only scope and pointer index to each field family.

nodes.name: Plugin load pipeline doc
nodes.summary: Startup load steps, safety gates, manifest-first behavior, activation reasons, plugin cache boundary and the registry model.

nodes.name: Registration mode doc
nodes.summary: Table of api.registrationMode values, when each occurs and what a plugin must register; runtime is unavailable in setup-only/cli-metadata.

nodes.name: Manifest vs package.json doc
nodes.summary: package.json#openclaw fields affecting discovery, install hints and compatibility, plus duplicate-plugin-id precedence order.

nodes.name: Tools/skills/plugins overview
nodes.summary: Decision guide distinguishing tools (typed callables), skills (prompt instructions) and plugins (code adding capabilities).

nodes.name: parseSkillFrontmatter
nodes.summary: Parses SKILL.md frontmatter via parseFrontmatterBlockResult and structuredClones the normalized record so caches do not retain the source file.

nodes.name: resolveSkillManifestMetadata
nodes.summary: Projects the metadata.openclaw block into always/emoji/homepage/skillKey/primaryEnv/os/requires/install.

nodes.name: resolveSkillInvocationPolicy
nodes.summary: Reads user-invocable (default true) and disable-model-invocation (default false).

nodes.name: resolveOpenClawManifestBlock
nodes.summary: Reads the metadata string field and parses it as JSON5, returning the OpenClaw manifest sub-object.

nodes.name: discoverSkillCandidates
nodes.summary: Bounded recursive discovery of SKILL.md candidates under a root with containment, symlink-target and budget enforcement.

nodes.name: discoverPluginSkills
nodes.summary: Validates generated plugin-skill symlink candidates whose realpaths stay inside declared plugin skill roots.

nodes.name: resolveWorkspaceSkillSourcePlan
nodes.summary: Builds the ordered skill root plan and worktree flags used by both local discovery and provisioned remote discovery.

nodes.name: resolveCustodianSkillAgentId
nodes.summary: Returns the configured system/Custodian agent id (or undefined) that alone may see custodian skills.

nodes.name: mergeSkillRecords
nodes.summary: Name-keyed merge keeping the highest-precedence record and recording collisions with distinct canonical paths.

nodes.name: filterSkillEntries
nodes.summary: Applies session/agent selection plus shouldIncludeSkill eligibility; the single filter across prompt, commands, sandbox sync and snapshots.

nodes.name: shouldIncludeSkill
nodes.summary: Load-time eligibility: config disable, degraded secret owner, bundled allowlist, then os/always/requires runtime evaluation.

nodes.name: resolveBundledAllowlist
nodes.summary: Normalizes skills.allowBundled into a set applied only to bundled/custodian sources.

nodes.name: resolveEffectiveAgentSkillFilter
nodes.summary: Per-agent skills list wins when present, else falls back to agents.defaults.skills; unknown agents also fall back to avoid widening access.

nodes.name: isSessionSkillEnabled
nodes.summary: Applies a session's sparse skill override after base-allowlist resolution.

nodes.name: prepareWorkspaceSkills
nodes.summary: Async runtime preparation: load sources, probe binaries with retry, filter and return eligible entries.

nodes.name: mergeSkillTiers
nodes.summary: Merges agent and execution tiers with remote node skills and library selections in precedence order.

nodes.name: loadSingleSkillDirectory
nodes.summary: Boundary-safe read of a skill directory's SKILL.md, then parse and materialize into a Skill.

nodes.name: materializeSkill
nodes.summary: Constructs the Skill record including displayName derived from the first H1 heading.

nodes.name: formatSkillsForPromptCore
nodes.summary: Renders the full <available_skills> XML catalog with escaped name/description/location.

nodes.name: compactSkillsPromptForContext
nodes.summary: Binary-searches a description length that fits the prompt budget while preserving every name/location identity.

nodes.name: parseSkillsPromptCatalog
nodes.summary: Extracts name/location identities from a rendered prompt catalog.

nodes.name: buildSkillsSection
nodes.summary: Emits the ## Skills section telling the model to read a listed location or use skills_read/skills_search.

nodes.name: createInstalledSkillTools
nodes.summary: Builds the skills_search and skills_read tools, binding read authority so a revoke also disables body indexing.

nodes.name: searchInstalledSkills
nodes.summary: Lexical search over eligible skill names/descriptions and bounded instruction bodies with coverage reporting.

nodes.name: readInstalledSkill
nodes.summary: Loads the complete SKILL.md for an exact name, rejecting instructions over 256 KiB rather than truncating.

nodes.name: buildWorkspaceSkillCommandSpecs
nodes.summary: Filters user-invocable skills and assembles unique slash-command specs for SDK consumers.

nodes.name: resolveSkillDispatchTools
nodes.summary: Policy-enforcement seam for command-dispatch:tool, applying the full tool-policy pipeline before a skill command invokes a tool.

nodes.name: resolvePluginSkillRoots
nodes.summary: Resolves plugin-declared skill roots from the plugin metadata snapshot and publishes generated symlinks.

nodes.name: publishPluginSkills
nodes.summary: Creates/refreshes generated symlinks under the plugin skills dir, removing stale OpenClaw-owned entries only.

nodes.name: readPluginSkill
nodes.summary: Serves a plugin skill preview by exact name, rejecting ambiguous names and changed plugin versions.

nodes.name: resolveWorkspaceSkillDirectories
nodes.summary: Returns the workspace skills dirs (skills/ then .agents/skills) at workspace precedence; workspaceOnly returns only skills/.

nodes.name: createPluginRuntimeApplication
nodes.summary: Projects the published registry's captured-code facts into a runtime application receipt, setting restartRequired when shared code cannot be swapped.

nodes.name: enablePluginInConfig
nodes.summary: Enables a plugin id in config, refusing when plugins are disabled, denied, or the restrictive allowlist omits it.

nodes.name: definePluginEntry
nodes.summary: Canonical entry helper for non-channel plugins; normalizes id/name/description/register and lazily evaluates configSchema.

nodes.name: defineBundledChannelEntry
nodes.summary: Channel entry helper that handles the registration-mode split so channel plugins register the right surfaces per mode.

nodes.name: resolveRuntimePluginRegistry
nodes.summary: Returns the active compatible registry or loads one without activating, avoiding recursion while a snapshot registers.

nodes.name: loadPluginRegistryHandle
nodes.summary: Loads a caller-owned registry value without changing the process-wide active registry.

nodes.name: loadBundleManifest
nodes.summary: Loads a compatible bundle manifest (Agent/Codex/Claude/Cursor layout) and its component paths.

nodes.name: joinClawHubPluginCatalog
nodes.summary: Joins ClawHub plugin catalog entries with local discovery identities for catalog/inspection views.

nodes.name: browseClawHubCatalog
nodes.summary: Browses the ClawHub plugin catalog with bounded pagination.

nodes.name: searchInstallablePluginPackages
nodes.summary: Searches installable plugin packages backing the plugin search surface.

nodes.name: checkClawHubPackageTrust
nodes.summary: Fetches and evaluates the exact-release ClawHub security verdict for a plugin or skill subject before install/update.

nodes.name: assessClawHubTrust
nodes.summary: Maps a ClawHub package security trust response to clean/review-recommended/review-required/blocked.

nodes.name: checkClawHubSkillTrust
nodes.summary: Skill-specific trust gate delegating to checkClawHubPackageTrust with the skill owner handle.

nodes.name: performClawHubSkillInstall
nodes.summary: Installs a tracked ClawHub skill: state assertion, version resolution, mutable-Git-ref rejection, trust check, archive download and verification.

nodes.name: verifySkillWithClawHub
nodes.summary: Asks ClawHub for a skill's trust envelope and formats request errors.

nodes.name: installSkillFromClawHub
nodes.summary: Top-level ClawHub skill install entry point.

nodes.name: updateSkillsFromClawHub
nodes.summary: Updates tracked ClawHub skills to their recorded versions, re-installing via the tracked path.

nodes.name: scanSkillContent
nodes.summary: Scans skill instruction content for dangerous patterns and returns findings.

nodes.name: scanSkillBundle
nodes.summary: Scans a skill bundle's file set and asserts it contains no literal secrets.

nodes.name: fetchClawHubPluginSkill
nodes.summary: Fetches a ClawHub release skill inventory plus one selected body without installing, enforcing bundle size limits.

nodes.name: PluginRegistry
nodes.summary: Central registry type holding plugin records (identity, source, origin, status, diagnostics) plus every capability array core reads.

nodes.name: PluginManifest
nodes.summary: Schema of openclaw.plugin.json: id and configSchema required, plus optional capability, activation, setup, skill, MCP, CLI, dashboard and QA metadata.

nodes.name: Skill
nodes.summary: Runtime skill shape: name, displayName?, description, locationNote?, readContent?, contentHash?, filePath, baseDir, discoveryRoot?, fileHost?, sourceInfo, disableModelInvocation, source.
